scope: One prepared Text block00 input only; no ORT, model execution, export, or production source edits

guard.signals: Only current Popen-owned sequential Node child; no VAE or other process signals

cachePolicy: No cache drop/fadvise; sequential blob then positional; times reflect cache/order and concurrent VAE activity

result.allocationPolicy: one caller-owned ArrayBuffer/Uint8Array, bounded fs.read directly into view
